niche: Real estate agents, brokers, investors & mortgage
about: Mix-and-match sections for real-estate homepages (solo agents, agencies, luxury brokers, investors / we-buy-houses, commercial groups, mortgage brokers), from 12 Dribbble full-page references in this folder (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS from different references. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. Property photography and the agent's portrait carry these designs: use the lead's real listings, agent headshot and local neighbourhood photos first, then architecture stock. Listing prices, sold counts, $ volume and ratings must come from FACTS — otherwise use neutral placeholders like 'Recently sold' without numbers.
